This formula has a DBE of 5, suggesting an aromatic ring (4 DBE) plus one additional unsaturation, likely a carbonyl. A common structure fitting this formula is 4‑methoxy‑acetophenone (p‑methoxyacetophenone), which has SMILES "COc1ccc(cc1)C(=O)C". This matches the formula and unsaturation count.</thought>
<final_answer>COc1ccc(cc1)C(=O)C</final_answer>
